jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.description:
Job Title: Head of Operations
Employment Status: Full-time
Office Hours: Monday - Friday; 4:1 hybrid schedule
Location: Boston, Massachusetts
Compensation: $175,000-200,000 base + variable + equity options
*compensation may be negotiated based on experience level

About Ketryx:

Ketryx is an AI platform that enables healthcare and life sciences companies to ship life-saving products in weeks instead of years.

Exploding product complexity is burying companies in compliance paperwork and blocking innovation. Our AI software removes this friction, dissolving the historical tradeoff between innovation and compliance, and enables regulated industries to innovate at the pace of modern software.

Ketryx already touches the lives of millions of patients and powers 4 of the world’s top 5 life science companies and 25% of the Fortune 500 life science market. Backed by Lightspeed Ventures, our founders are the former Head of AI at Amgen and CTO of Wolfram Cloud.

Healthcare and life sciences is just the beginning for us. Automotive, aerospace, energy — if it’s regulated, it’s because society decided it matters. These products move humanity, shape our future, and are safety-critical. Come join us and help build the AI platform to power safe innovation.

The Role

We're hiring a Head of Operations to own all things operations & people as Ketryx scales. You'll inherit a small, capable team and a company that is growing quickly across the US and Europe, with all the ambiguity and opportunity that comes with it. Your mandate is over the people here at Ketryx & how we work, by building + refining our systems, hiring engine, and culture that allow us to grow fast and execute without losing what makes our team effective.

This is a hands-on leadership role based in Boston, including quarterly travel to our Vienna office. You'll set our strategy around cross-functional collaboration, be responsible for designing how we work, and answer a tactical People question in Slack. Our customers build products that keep people alive. The faster we help them ship safely, the sooner these products reach patients. How well we hire, develop, and support our own team is critical!

You will report to Erez, our CEO and Co-founder

Responsibilities

Culture and Collaboration

- Ensure our values are incorporated into how we work every day at Ketryx, focusing on creating an environment where people can execute on a world-class level

- Own performance management: goal setting, review cycles, calibration, and the harder conversations that follow

- Build manager capability across a team where many leaders are first-time managers

- Run engagement measurement and, more importantly, act on what it tells us

People Operations & Compensation

- Own HRIS, payroll, benefits, onboarding, and offboarding across US and European entities

- Build process where it removes friction and resist it where it doesn't

- Build out a leveling framework, compensation bands, and equity philosophy that hold up across engineering, GTM, and G&A

- Maintain employment compliance across multiple countries and states as we expand

- Run market benchmarking and annual comp cycles in partnership with Finance

Talent acquisition and scaling

- Build a hiring engine that consistently lands senior engineers, GTM talent, and life sciences domain experts in a competitive market

- Partner with leadership on headcount planning and sequencing — what we hire, when, and why

- Raise the bar on interview design, structured evaluation, and candidate experience so hiring decisions are consistent and defensible

- Develop Ketryx's employer brand to help us attract high-caliber talent

Required Skills

- 8+ years in HR/People Operations with at least three leading the function or a major pillar of it, especially at high growth startups

- Strong opinions on what can work, a willingness to try something new, and a network of People leaders to tap into for broader questions

- Direct experience scaling a company through significant headcount growth — you've seen what breaks at 100, 200, 500 people and have opinions about it

- Comfort operating without a large team or established playbook — you build the thing and then run it

- Strong recruiting instincts; you can assess engineering and GTM talent markets and partner credibly with engineering leaders

- Demonstrated ownership of compensation and leveling design

- Multi-country employment experience (US and EU) or clear evidence you can get up to speed fast

- Sound judgment in ambiguous, confidential situations, and the directness to bring hard news to the leadership team early

Preferred Skills

- Experience supporting distributed teams across US and European time zones

What We Offer

- Competitive compensation

- Generous stock options possible

- Work in an exciting field with a positive impact on the world

- Opportunity to learn and grow as part of a global team

- Generous PTO for full-time

Ketryx is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances

Ketryx is saving and improving lives by making medical software safe and reliable. We empower software teams building medical applications to create safe, secure, and compliant products used by patients and providers worldwide. We believe that, by automating much of the documentation and quality processes, teams will be able to produce safer and more innovative medical software faster.

Ketryx is at the forefront of helping teams incorporate AI/ML into medical software and that’s why we need you!

jobs.title: Channel and Strategic Partnerships Director
jobs.description:
Job Title: Channel and Strategic Partnerships Director
Employment Status:  Full-time
Office Hours: Monday - Friday; hybrid schedule
Location:  Boston, Massachusetts
Compensation: competitive salary + equity
*compensation may be negotiated based on experience level

Reporting directly to our CEO, this is a rare opportunity to build Ketryx’s partner ecosystem from the ground up. As our first Channel & Partnerships Director, you’ll design and own a partner-led growth engine that drives revenue, trust, and long-term market expansion. You’ll create and operationalize programs that bring together two powerful channels: enterprise technology platforms like Atlassian and Siemens, and boutique consulting firms in regulatory, quality, and cybersecurity.

You won’t be inheriting a bloated, outdated partner model—you’ll craft the blueprint yourself, with full executive support and visibility. You’ll work at the intersection of commercial strategy, AI, and category creation, enabling new routes to market for a platform that’s already trusted by three of the top five global MedTech companies. If you’ve ever wanted to build something career-defining—and watch it scale across industries that quite literally impact lives—this is the role.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas (including H-1B), F-1 visas, or Optional Practical Training (OPT) status at this time.

About you

You’re a strategic operator who’s managed multiple types of partnerships, including enterprise tech alliances, and now you’re ready to own the full build of a partner program from the ground up. Cultivating strong relationships with key stakeholders across partner organizations, from frontline consultants to senior executives, to drive alignment and influence is in your DNA. You love crafting structure where none exists: defining partner tiers, building incentive models, and crafting joint GTM motions that result in pipeline.

You thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments, and you’re excited to work shoulder to shoulder with the CEO and executive team to launch something category-defining and build the system that helps Ketryx define the next frontier in validated AI for regulated industries.

Responsibilities

- Build and launch Ketryx’s partner program from the ground up including tiering, incentives, onboarding flows, and co-sell enablement across both technology and consulting partners

- Identify, recruit, and activate high-leverage partners; Own the structuring and negotiation of partnership agreements in collaboration with legal and executive leadership

- Develop and operationalize co-selling motions defining how we work with partners to share leads, align on deals, and accelerate sales through trusted third parties

- Drive measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by working closely with Sales and RevOps to attribute impact, optimize efforts, and hit pipeline contribution goals

- Manage and grow long-term partner relationships through maintaining regular touchpoints, facilitating joint planning, and ensuring partner success through clear incentives and engagement models

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Product to align messaging, surface integration opportunities, and ensure partners are equipped with the right tools and stories

- Track and report on partner performance

Required Skills

- Must have 5+ years demonstrated experience in strategic business development, technology alliances, product management/marketing, technical/solution marketing or technical sales enablement role at a SaaS technology provider. Mix of start-up and public company experience preferred

- Proven track record of closing high-impact partnerships with large enterprise platforms (e.g., Atlassian, AWS, etc.) and driving measurable revenue through joint go-to-market and co-selling motions

- Strong entrepreneurial drive and ownership mindset; you thrive in ambiguity, self-initiate new motions, and build systems where none exist

- Successful track record of designing partnership structures and revenue-sharing agreements that create aligned incentives and real commercial outcomes

- Highly analytical and strategic thinker with the ability to develop partner scoring rubrics, co-selling frameworks, and tiering models that scale

- Comfortable building pricing models, incentive plans, and forecasting partner-sourced revenue in collaboration with RevOps and finance

- Excellent communicator and storyteller, with strong marketing sensibility

- Experience building and executing partner briefs, co-marketing campaigns, and enablement materials that drive engagement and lead flow

- Comfortable working cross-functionally with legal, product, sales, and marketing to bring structured partner programs to life, from contracting to launch

Keywords: Strategic business development, channel partner management, joint go-to-market strategy, partner-led growth, pipeline generation, regulatory technology, commercial strategy, market expansion, partner tiering, co-marketing campaigns, sales enablement, RevOps collaboration, partnership ROI, strategic partnerships, quality management systems, revenue forecasting, partnership analytics, executive visibility, high-growth environment, market penetration
